arguments.content:
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Read values (data_only=True to get cached formula results if present)
wb = load_workbook("budget.xlsx", data_only=True)
ws = wb["Budget"]

rows = []
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    item = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    rows.append((cat, item, amt))

df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["Category", "Item", "Amount"])

print("Expense rows:")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print()

total = df["Amount"].sum()
print(f"Total expenses (all categories): ${total:,.2f}")

per_cat = df.groupby("Category")["Amount"].sum()
print("\nPer-category totals:")
for cat, amt in per_cat.items():
    print(f"  {cat}: ${amt:,.2f}")
print(f"  TOTAL: ${per_cat.sum():,.2f}")

# Cross-check with the workbook's own formula cell
print("\nWorkbook Total Expenses cell C23:", ws["C23"].value)
print("Workbook cached value for C23:", ws["C23"].value if not isinstance(ws["C23"].value, str) else "(formula, no cached value)")
